items.why: Shares surge on Jensen Huang's return, adding about $1tn in value and leading the Nasdaq rebound.
Volatility plunges as stocks rebound in the relief rally lifting the major indexes.

market_note: Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures surged amid a relief rally.
summary: Stocks are roaring back in a relief rally, led by Nvidia on Jensen Huang's return. The Nasdaq is up about 7% and the S&P 500 is rebounding 5% as buyers step back in.
